newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Banco Sud Americano signs loan deal.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Banco Sud Americano signs loan deal.

text.p: Chile's Banco Sud Americano and the Dresdner Bank Luxembourg on Thursday signed a deal repricing a $50 million loan, cutting the spread to 0.3 percent from 0.75 percent, said officials.
"This is the cheapest loan obtained by a private bank in Chile," said John Byrne, executive vice president at Sud Americano.
Sud Americano, Chile's fifth largest private bank, signed the credit last year.
Byrne said the bank was planning to set up an agency in the United States next year to provide services to Chilean clients with business elsewhere in Latin America.
"We are trying to set it up as soon as possible and have already completed our own internal study," he said.
Obtaining approval from the Chilean and U.S. authorities will take at least nine months, he added.
Sud Americano is 30-percent owned by Canada's Bank of Nova Scotia.
